points.description: Setup: the data is labelled with positive/negative (+/-) classes (e.g. flipping/handling negatives so one rule works) and the weights are initialised (randomly).

Update rule: for a point that is misclassified (e.g. <w,x> <= 0 in the simplified form), update the weights by adding eta times the point, Δw = eta*x(n) (equivalent forms such as w += eta*y*x for misclassified points are accepted).

Iteration and stopping: the update is repeated over all data points for multiple epochs until the weights no longer change (much), i.e. convergence; may note that convergence is guaranteed because the data is linearly separable.
